name: HHEM-2.1-Open
purpose: Local factual-consistency scoring for premise/context and hypothesis/response pairs.

security_review.network_boundary: Custom code fetches only static google/flan-t5-base config/tokenizer assets through Transformers; no user text is passed to the hub.
security_review.execution_boundary: Only this exact revision is allowed; safetensors is preferred and model weights/cache stay outside the repository.

cache_behavior: Use a normal external Hugging Face cache; never commit model weights or cache files.
